rules.proactive: Per DESIGN.md, an inspection 'for unrelated reasons' does not count as targeting a fault's mechanism. We adjudicate behaviorally: a run counts as proactive iff at least one PLANTED fault was fixed before that fault's specific error message ever appeared in a checker output (fault absent from the run's surfaced-error order, or fix index < error index). Mechanism-revealing scans that the run did not act on ahead of the error are recorded but do not count; they are surveying, not finding. Borderline notes inline.
rules.solution_accuracy: Accurate = all four planted faults enumerated (exec bit + CRLF combinable as one script problem per DESIGN) and no false claims. The Kimi Code runs' extra pytest/site-packages item describes a real condition of that harness's sandbox (isolated HOME per bouts/2026-07-18-kimi-homegame/DESIGN.md), verified against their transcripts; a true extra is not an 'invented extra'.
